lesson_title: Lesson 2: Design Thinking Principles and Empathy
lesson_description: In this lesson, students explore the core principles of design thinking, focusing on human-centered design and empathy-building techniques. They will engage in role-playing activities and group discussions to understand the innovation process, conduct interviews for empathy, and validate solutions using the Forge 231 Ovation Rubric. Students will also learn about user-centric innovation, including problem validation, customer discovery, and user personas, through case studies and the customer development process. Additionally, they will apply design thinking tools such as Minimum Usable Prototypes, value proposition design, and systematic concept generation to develop and test compelling solutions.
